content.title: Chapter 42 - FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION — Sec. 42-85. - I.F.C. Section 3310.3.3, Dead ends.
content.summary:
Section 3310.3.3. Dead ends
, is hereby added to read as follows:
"3310.3.3. Dead ends.
Dead-end temporary fire apparatus access roads in excess of 150 feet (45,720 mm)
                  in length shall be provided with an approved area for turning around fire apparatus."
